name: TheNFT burn keeps the token approval
summary: TheNFT's burn() pays the owner 1 DAO and moves the NFT to the dead address 0x74eda0 without clearing its single-token approval, and transferFrom honours that approval for the dead address. The attacker approved itself, burned, pulled the NFT back from the dead address and repeated, draining the DAO tokens backing TheNFT V1 and then V2 (same code), and sold them into the DAO/WETH pair.
notes: Anchor is the attacker's first transaction, on V1 (0x26683023), 26 blocks before the DeFiHackLabs V2 transaction 0xd5b4d684; V2 (0x79a7d355, deployed later) carries the same burn and transferFrom code and is a sibling target of the same campaign (rule 4). No Transfer out of 0x74eda0 occurred on V1 or V2 before the anchor.

DAO (16 decimals) has no DefiLlama price; valued at the WETH the attackers realised selling it into the DAO/WETH pair 0xe1ecadb5 (10.123113 WETH, plus 0.03 WETH by the copycat 0xdc1bb906), at ETH's price at each block (rule 12).

Later burn-and-reclaim calls by the curator's Redeemer 0x01d7b772 (deployed by the TheNFT deployer to recover DAO for users) are affiliated and left V1 and V2 net zero (loss.mjs over every later exercise).
